risk: Official 2018/2011/2005 GIS or gazette maps are unavailable or not licensed for reuse
mitigation: Request GCC GIS/records; use gazette PDFs for verification; obtain written permission; keep OpenCity layer provisional
Build event-specific boundary versions and crosswalks; never compare wards across versions without a crosswalk; rerun labels

risk: Sentinel-1 has no acquisition during the 2023 flood peak (last pre 2023-11-30; next 2024-01-17)
mitigation: Do not claim 2023 peak mapping; use far post-event/change or complementary SAR/optical; mark unknown where unsupported

risk: Only descending track 92; no ascending GRD-HD found over the bbox
mitigation: Document look geometry; assess layover/shadow; seek complementary SAR or ascending products if available

risk: Urban SAR false positives/negatives (double bounce, metal roofs, shadow, small streets)
mitigation: Use VV/VH, pre/post change, permanent-water masks, morphological cleanup, manual review, threshold sensitivity

risk: Negative labels are scarce; absence of detection is not dryness
mitigation: Require high valid coverage plus independent non-inundation evidence; otherwise label unknown; never fill negatives from missing data

risk: Historical land-cover/impervious/drainage features are not event-matched
mitigation: Use ESA CCI/GHSL/WorldCover with vintage flags; test static vs historical feature sensitivity; defer unreliable layers

risk: Ward overlaps and boundary-edge ambiguity can change labels/features
mitigation: Use authoritative boundaries; classify overlaps; report label sensitivity under overlap policies; never arbitrarily transfer area

risk: GFD CC BY-NC and OpenCity unspecified licence restrict redistribution/commercial use
mitigation: Confirm terms in writing; keep derived layers private until cleared; preserve attribution; use permissible sources

risk: GEE is free only for eligible noncommercial research; commercial use is paid
mitigation: Confirm eligibility; prefer ASF/CDSE free access for research; budget any commercial/cloud export costs

risk: Event windows/peak dates and rainfall forcing are not independently verified
mitigation: Use IMD/TNSDMA/GCC reports; pre-register observation windows before looking at labels; keep rainfall separate from susceptibility

risk: Compute/storage costs for SAR stacks and processing
mitigation: Use cloud-optimised/COG, AOI subsetting, one track, only necessary dates; estimate before download
